verdict.rationale: Pylon documents AI Issue QA rubrics that can be applied to issues and enforced "on the agent and issue level". Its Monitor & Iterate issue log lets reviewers inspect the outcomes and steps the AI agent took, and runbooks and skills give a place to put fixes. However, the docs never show that rubric scoring targets AI-agent conversations specifically, or that it runs as ongoing sampled scoring. Missing for 10: explicit scoring of AI-agent conversations with sampling, automatic flagging of failed conversations, a documented review loop that turns QA findings into agent fixes, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a support ops lead, AI conversations get ongoing QA — scored samples, flagged failures, and a review loop that feeds fixes back into the agent

citations.quote: Create rubrics to enforce that processes are being followed on the agent and issue level.
